label: Spatially correlated ground-motion residual field

period_s.description: Spectral period of the IM the field multiplies; sets the correlation range. Required for jayaram-baker-2009.

vs30_clustered.description: Jayaram & Baker (2009) case 2 (Vs30 clustered, b = 40.7 - 15.0 T) rather than case 1 (b = 8.5 + 17.2 T). Matters only below T = 1 s; at and above it b = 22.0 + 3.7 T either way.

truncation_level.description: Truncate each independent standard normal at this many standard deviations before correlating, as OpenQuake does; null for none.

source.citation: Jayaram, N. and Baker, J. W. (2009). Correlation model for spatially distributed ground-motion intensities. Earthquake Engineering & Structural Dynamics 38(15), 1687-1708.
source.implementation_reference: OpenQuake engine, openquake/hazardlib/shakemap/gmfs.py: spatial_correlation_array and to_gmfs (correlation exp(-3h/b), truncated independent normals, then the covariance root).

description: One joint draw over every Bridge in the binding: epsilon = L z, with L L' = R, R_ij = exp(-3 h_ij / b) and h_ij the great-circle distance in km. L is the symmetric root from an eigendecomposition rather than a Cholesky factor, so bridges at the same location (correlation 1) do not make it fail. Applied to ShakeMap's conditional standard deviations this is OpenQuake's approximation: the correlation is the unconditional model's, not the one conditioned on the stations.
